title: 店铺销售Top5
query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日下单且实付金额大于0的订单，返回销售额最高的5家店铺名称和实付金额合计。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: SELECT stores.store_name AS "店铺名称", SUM(orders.paid_amount) AS "实付金额合计" FROM orders JOIN stores ON stores.store_id = orders.store_id WHERE orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-08-23' AS TIMESTAMP) AND orders.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY stores.store_name ORDER BY SUM(orders.paid_amount) DESC LIMIT 5
